title: sabulina decandra
intro: Sabulina decandra, commonly known as Indian squill, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Asparagaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties, and its use as a remedy for fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Sabulina decandra are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, saponins, and glycosides, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat various other health conditions, including digestive issues and wounds, due to its ability to stimulate the immune system and promote tissue repair.
